CC BY 4.0, ESTABLISHED 2026-08-18 FROM THE PUBLISHER'S OWN NOTICE. finance.gov.au/about-us/copyright-notice: "All material presented on this website is provided under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence, with the exception of: the Commonwealth Coat of Arms, Finance's logo, content supplied by third parties, material protected by trademark, any images and/or photographs, other content as specified." Required attribution, verbatim from the notice: "(c) Commonwealth of Australia, Department of Finance [title of the work and publication year]". The workbook's own "(c) Commonwealth of Australia 2026" line asserts copyright and states no terms, so the site-wide grant supplies them under its "unless otherwise noted" clause. Read via web.archive.org snapshot 20250708202113 because finance.gov.au still returns HTTP 000 from our environment — the host is unreachable, not the licence unknowable, and the distinction is the whole reason this took two days.
